_about: Truemeds decisions on top of SALT, owned in this folder (approved by Apurva, layout v2, 2026-10-14). Applied LAST by scripts/build.py (truemeds.css) and scripts/build_native.py (native/). A SALT re-export never touches this file. Values are palette references (core:<family>-<shade>) or [size, line-height, weight] for text styles. Listed in beyond-salt.md.

size._about: Sizes with no SALT token, added by D-98 (Sign-in hand-off kit). Values in px (web) / points (native). CSS: --tm-<group>-<name>; native: tokens.<group>.<name>. [PROPOSED], listed in beyond-salt.md.

layout._about: Web only (D-99): page and panel widths for portals and desktop screens. Exported to native for completeness; a phone app does not use them.

scale._about: Values that are not px sizes, added by D-99 (token pass). CSS: --tm-<group>-<name>: <value><_unit>; native: tokens.<group>.<name> as a plain number or string (no unit). [PROPOSED], listed in beyond-salt.md.

pressed._about: Multiplier for the pressed look of the solid call-end button (CSS brightness()). Native: draw it as a darker fill or a dark overlay.

shadow._about: Truemeds shadows with no SALT equivalent (D-62 action bar, D-99 token). Exported like the SALT shadows in extras.json.
